purpose: Transparent descriptive gene sets for cross-assay stromal hypothesis review; no validated activity score is implied.

panels.label: TGF-beta ligands, receptors and SMAD machinery
panels.interpretation_limit: Mixed positive and inhibitory components; total protein is not active ligand or phospho-SMAD.

panels.label: Latent TGF-beta handling and activation
panels.interpretation_limit: Integrin subunits are not proof of heterodimer formation or active TGF-beta; LTBP2 is contextual and does not directly bind latent TGF-beta like other LTBPs.

panels.label: Activated fibroblast and remodelling context
panels.interpretation_limit: Hand-curated context panel, not a validated CAF classifier; bulk cell origin is unknown.

panels.label: Published LRRC15/TGF-beta CAF 11-gene set
panels.interpretation_limit: Published gene membership from Dominguez2020; descriptive protein coverage/ranks are not the published transcriptomic response score or classifier.

panels.label: Broad collagen and matrix structure
panels.interpretation_limit: Abundance can reflect normal connective tissue, anatomy, wound repair or tumour stroma; not an exclusion readout.

panels.label: Collagen maturation, cross-linking and tension
panels.interpretation_limit: Total enzyme presence is not substrate cross-linking, stiffness or enzyme activity.

panels.label: Matrix proteolysis and remodelling balance
panels.interpretation_limit: Proteases and inhibitors have distinct and sometimes opposing effects; no activity score inferred.

panels.label: Hyaluronan and glycosaminoglycan context
panels.interpretation_limit: Bulk protein cannot quantify hyaluronan polymer content, size or interstitial pressure.

panels.label: Integrin, FAK and collagen sensing
panels.interpretation_limit: Protein abundance is not phospho-FAK, matrix alignment, extracellular DDR1 shedding or pathway activation.

panels.label: YAP/TAZ-associated mechanotransduction context
panels.interpretation_limit: Contains effectors and inhibitory machinery; not a directional YAP score. CCN1=CYR61 and CCN2=CTGF; TGFBI differs from TGFB1.

panels.label: Chemokine retention and myeloid recruitment
panels.interpretation_limit: Ligand presence does not establish secretion, gradient, receptor co-location or exclusion.

panels.label: IL-1/IL-6-family inflammatory fibroblast context
panels.interpretation_limit: Inflammation and phospho-STAT3 cannot be inferred from bulk receptor/total STAT abundance.

panels.label: Macrophage-stroma and collagen immune receptors
panels.interpretation_limit: Bulk coexistence is not a spatial macrophage-CAF niche or ligand-receptor activity.

panels.label: Endothelial and vascular access context
panels.interpretation_limit: Mixed endothelial state and adhesion markers; vascular dysfunction, perfusion or FasL-mediated killing are unmeasured.

panels.label: Pericyte and mural-cell composition control
panels.interpretation_limit: Markers overlap with other stromal states; this is a confounding/context control, not deconvolution.

panels.label: Smooth-muscle composition control
panels.interpretation_limit: Strong expression can be native bowel-wall smooth muscle rather than suppressive fibroblasts.

panels.label: Epithelial composition control
panels.interpretation_limit: Comparator panel only, not a tumour-purity estimator; endogenous keratins may be contaminant-library flagged.

panels.label: T-cell/NK presence and interferon-driven recruitment
panels.interpretation_limit: Low-abundance bulk non-detection is not immune-cell absence; spatial location and tumour specificity unmeasured.

panels.label: MHC-II/APC-associated stromal context
panels.interpretation_limit: These proteins are not specific to antigen-presenting CAFs; need same-cell lineage localisation.

panels.label: Stromal adenosine, hypoxia and acid-sensing context
panels.interpretation_limit: Metabolites, receptor function and stromal versus tumour/immune origin are unmeasured.
